quests.desc: Welcome to another fast paced episode of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, move south. After that, go east. With that done, attempt to go to the north. Then, make an attempt to venture east. After that, lift the passkey from the floor of the chamber. And if you do that, you're the winner!

infos.desc:

 You see a safe.[if c_0 is open and there is something in the c_0] The safe contains [a list of things in the c_0].[end if][if c_0 is open and the c_0 contains nothing] The safe is empty, what a horrible day![end if]

 There is [if d_7 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] gateway leading west. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unblocked.

objective: Welcome to TextWorld! First of all, head south. Then, take a trip east. If you can do that, make an attempt to move north. And then, make an effort to head east. After that, lift the passkey from the floor of the chamber. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
